events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its first music video.

angles.name: Impact of MTV
angles.copy: Remember when MTV actually played music videos? Forty-five years ago today, it all began with The Buggles. Did video really kill the radio star?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album, Definitely Maybe, on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Album Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago this month, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the Woodstock Festival kicked off, bringing together half a million people for '3 Days of Peace & Music'. Imagine being there!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, born January 8, 1935, passed away on August 16, 1977, and would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: King of Rock & Roll
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away 49 years ago. His music continues to influence generations.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur, born June 16, 1971, was fatally shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and passed away on September 13, 1996. He would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago this month, the world lost a lyrical genius. We remember the enduring impact of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, born November 27, 1942, passed away on September 18, 1970, and would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: On this day, we honour the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us 56 years ago this month. His guitar wizardry remains legendary.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album Abbey Road on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Magic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago this month, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. The album cover is as legendary as the music. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today, born September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman is still rocking. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today, born September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Mad for it
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation is another year older. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's "Imagine" Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album Imagine on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago this month, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and hope that still resonates today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Music in your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the day music truly became portable? Twenty-five years ago this month, Apple launched the iPod. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Today marks 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit cinemas. Who's your favourite Bond and what's your top Bond theme song?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon, born on October 9, 1940, would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today, born October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Sound
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago this month, The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What's your standout track?
